newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: S.Lanka's NDB up 2 pct on growth prospect.
newsitem.headline: S.Lanka's NDB up 2 pct on growth prospect.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lanka's National Development Bank rose by five rupees, or two percent, to 250 on Tuesday on better growth prospects for 1997, brokers said.
"NDB being one of the largest financial institutions will tend to recover with the economy," said a broker with Forbes & Walker stock brokers.
He said that NDB also had a large amount of unrealised profits from their underwriting of plantation shares at par. Plantation shares have risen sharply in the past weeks.
Brokers said potential capital gains and overall positive sentiment regarding the economy should boost the share price further.
